# Six Seven

> Six Seven is a fast food and coffee brand in DHA Phase 4 Lahore, Pakistan.

Six Seven serves beef burgers, loaded snacks, signature drinks, iced teas, smoothies, frappes, iced coffees and hot coffees. Customers can order online for delivery or pickup from the DHA Phase 4 Lahore branch.

## Menu Highlights

- Food: beef burgers, wraps, loaded fries, fries, cheese balls, chicken strips, waffles, mini pancakes and combo meals.
- Signature drinks: strawberry rush, mango burst, peach breeze, berry cola and signature refreshers.
- Iced teas: peach iced tea, strawberry iced tea and passion fruit iced tea.
- Smoothies and frappes: mango smoothie, strawberry smoothie, blackberry smoothie, mocha frappe, caramel frappe and pistachio frappe.
- Coffee: espresso, americano, latte, iced coffee and related hot or cold coffee drinks.
